# 2 Chronicles 6 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 6 (42 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.3
- **EMET:** "And-he-turned the-king his-face and-he-blessed all assembly-of Israel and-all assembly-of Israel was-standing."
- **LOGOS:** "Then the king turned his face and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood."
- **PNEUMA:** "Then the king turned around and blessed the whole assembly of Israel as they stood there."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.9
- **EMET:** "only you not you-shall-build the-house but your-son the-coming-out from-your-loins he shall-build the-house for-My-name."

- **PNEUMA:** "Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it. Instead, your own son will build the temple for My name.'"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
